versions.changelog:
Initial release: Manage and coordinate tasks among multiple AI agent departments.

- Organize AI agents into user-defined departments for specialized workflows.
- Assign, track, and complete tasks within and across departments.
- Commands for creating, listing, and removing departments; assigning and completing tasks; generating department reports.
- Supports setting department roles, models, and custom responsibilities.
- Stores all department/project data locally for persistence and review.
